items.title: Rico Dowdle: Rushing TD in big win
items.text:
Dowdle rushed 15 times for 56 yards and a touchdown in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.

items.title: Aaron Rodgers: Modest production in Week 8 win
